title: The Mandalorian Luke Skywalker Deepfake
summary: Deepfake artist Shamook's improved version of the Luke Skywalker scene from The Mandalorian season 2 finale, replacing the official CGI face with a deepfake.
why: HN cites it as an example of deepfakes producing a more convincing CGI human than the studio's own effort.

quote.text: Youtuber Shamook did just that with the finale of the Mandalorian season 2.
